beforeSave.source:
//@version=5
indicator("V76 var tuple method v5")
type Probe
    int value
method f(Probe self) => [self.value, self.value + 1]
holder = Probe.new(1)
var [a, b] = holder.f()
plot(a, "A")
plot(b, "B")
plot(1, "VALUE")
